coverage.headline: McDermott Secures Record-Fast Chapter 11 Confirmation for BlockFills
coverage.summary: Judge Thomas M. Horan confirmed BlockFills' Chapter 11 plan on July 13, 2026, just 122 days after the March 15 petition — described by counsel as one of the most efficient crypto bankruptcy cases ever filed. The McDermott team, led by Darren Azman and Joseph B. Evans, called it the first case at the intersection of crypto, derivatives, and insolvency.

coverage.headline: Keyrock acquires BlockFills trading assets in institutional crypto expansion
coverage.summary: Keyrock completed its acquisition of BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage assets for $3.25 million following court approval of the Chapter 11 sale. The deal adds institutional client relationships, derivatives trading technology, regulatory licenses (CIMA/Cayman, pending FCA/UK), and several senior BlockFills executives to Keyrock.

coverage.headline: Keyrock closes deal for BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage assets
coverage.summary: Keyrock announced completion of its acquisition of BlockFills' institutional trading and brokerage operations for $3.25 million out of Chapter 11 bankruptcy, gaining proprietary technology, institutional client relationships, and regulatory licenses.

coverage.headline: Crypto Firm BlockFills Gets OK For $3.25M Ch. 11 Sale
coverage.summary: A Delaware bankruptcy judge approved the $3.25 million sale of BlockFills' assets to Belgian digital asset firm Keyrock as the debtor simultaneously prepared for a Chapter 11 plan confirmation hearing.

coverage.headline: Digital asset firm Keyrock plans to acquire BlockFills out of bankruptcy
coverage.summary: Brussels-based Keyrock SA was declared the successful bidder for substantially all of BlockFills' assets at a purchase price of $3.25 million, subject to court approval at a June 16, 2026 hearing.

coverage.headline: BlockFills Can Send Ch. 11 Plan Out For Creditor Votes
coverage.summary: A Delaware bankruptcy judge conditionally approved BlockFills' Chapter 11 plan disclosure statement, clearing the way for creditor solicitation while reserving arguments over the plan's opt-out release mechanism for the confirmation hearing.

coverage.headline: BlockFills Files for Chapter 11 Bankruptcy After Crypto Market Turmoil
coverage.summary: Chicago-based cryptocurrency brokerage BlockFills filed for Chapter 11 protection in Delaware after months of market turmoil, with operating entity Reliz Ltd. listing up to $500 million in liabilities against $50–$100 million in assets. The filing followed the suspension of customer withdrawals amid a broader crypto market downturn.

coverage.headline: Crypto trading firm BlockFills files for bankruptcy
coverage.summary: BlockFills filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after halting customer withdrawals in February following approximately $75 million in losses and a lawsuit alleging misappropriation of customer assets. The firm said the filing was intended to preserve business value and maximize recoveries for stakeholders through a court-supervised restructuring process.
